articles.summary: Fort Lauderdale, FL (August 20, 2026) — Amerant Bank, Florida’s bank of choice, and Fort Lauderdale United FC today announced that the venue on Nova Southeastern University’s campus will now be known as Amerant Bank Field. articles.title: Amerant Bank and Fort Lauderdale United FC Unveil Amerant Bank Field at Nova Southeastern University
